title: Do not hide the notifications icon if they are not deleted
line: The Notifications icon now stays in the System Tray while there are notifications in its history, instead of hiding as soon as you open it once.
explanation: The Notifications applet set its status to Passive whenever there were no unread notifications, no running jobs and no dismissed resident notifications. Opening the popup marks everything as read, so the bell disappeared into the System Tray overflow while the notifications were still in the history. The applet now also stays Active while the history holds any expired notifications (the same count that enables "Clear All Notifications"), so it hides only once the history is empty.

commits.message:
applets/notifications: stay visible while notifications are in history

The icon went passive as soon as no notification was unread, so opening
the popup once hid it in the System Tray's overflow even though the
notifications were still there. Keep it active until history is empty.

BUG: 436491

patches.diff:
From fbe110ddd2c3ba96e6d2829510ff5d18cddab2de Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 02:35:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/notifications: stay visible while notifications are
 in history

The icon went passive as soon as no notification was unread, so opening
the popup once hid it in the System Tray's overflow even though the
notifications were still there. Keep it active until history is empty.

BUG: 436491
---
 applets/notifications/main.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/applets/notifications/main.qml b/applets/notifications/main.qml
index 8d98753eca..3b83763843 100644
--- a/applets/notifications/main.qml
+++ b/applets/notifications/main.qml
@@ -35,6 +35,7 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     readonly property int effectiveStatus: historyModel.activeJobsCount > 0
                      || historyModel.unreadNotificationsCount > 0
+                     || historyModel.expiredNotificationsCount > 0
                      || historyModel.dismissedResidentNotificationsCount > 0
                      || Notifications.Globals.inhibited ? PlasmaCore.Types.ActiveStatus
                                           : PlasmaCore.Types.PassiveStatus
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Before: one notification in history, popup opened from the bell
Before: after closing the popup the bell is gone, though the notification is still there
After: same notification, popup opened from the bell
After: the bell stays in the tray while the notification is in history
After: dismissing the last notification still hides the bell and closes the popup

review.text: Adding historyModel.expiredNotificationsCount > 0 to effectiveStatus in applets/notifications/main.qml directly fixes the root cause so the Notifications tray icon stays visible while notifications remain in history instead of disappearing as soon as the popup is opened once. Reusing expiredNotificationsCount matches the exact condition already used to show the Clear All Notifications action, and the existing deferred PassiveStatus transition still closes the popup and hides the icon once the last notification is dismissed. The commit message, diff, and before/after screenshots cleanly prove the fix with no regressions.

reviews.text: Adding historyModel.expiredNotificationsCount > 0 to effectiveStatus in applets/notifications/main.qml directly fixes the root cause so the Notifications tray icon stays visible while notifications remain in history instead of disappearing as soon as the popup is opened once. Reusing expiredNotificationsCount matches the exact condition already used to show the Clear All Notifications action, and the existing deferred PassiveStatus transition still closes the popup and hides the icon once the last notification is dismissed. The commit message, diff, and before/after screenshots cleanly prove the fix with no regressions.

This does what the reporter asked and Nate agreed to: the bell stays Active while anything remains in history and hides once it is empty. The one-line change uses the same expiredNotificationsCount that already drives the Clear All button, so the icon and the popup's contents stay consistent, and the existing Qt.callLater passive-collapse path still handles dismissing the last notification (after-3). The screenshots clearly show the bell gone before and kept after, and the commit text and explanation match the diff. History is in memory only, so the bell will not stay visible forever across sessions.
